name: Wolf Heart Samples
summary: In Silverpine Forest, wolf hearts carry a poison their living hosts endure. Apothecary Renferrel sends samples to the Royal Apothecary Society for study.

sections.title: A Toxic Paradox
sections.body: While examining carcasses in Silverpine Forest, Apothecary Renferrel found a deadly compound in certain wolf hearts. The poison fills their tissue at a strength that should kill them, yet the wolves live. Renferrel set tissue samples aside for delivery to Undercity. The Forsaken study creatures that endure toxins as they seek mastery of biological warfare and prepare new reagents.

sections.title: Consignment to Undercity
sections.body: Couriers carry the samples beneath the ruins of Lordaeron to Apothecary Zinge. She works at the Royal Apothecary Society's headquarters in the Apothecarium. Zinge and her colleagues prize new toxins. They dissect and test the tainted tissue to isolate its virulent compounds and learn how the beasts survive them. They hope to use that knowledge in their alchemical work.

faq.q: Why are these wolf hearts significant to the Forsaken?
aliases: why do apothecaries want wolf hearts
faq.answer: The wolf hearts contain intense toxicity with no known cause, though it should have killed their hosts. The Royal Apothecary Society seeks to understand the poison and how the wolves survive it.

Apothecary Renferrel collected the samples after studying wolves in Silverpine Forest. He arranged for a courier to take them to his colleague, Apothecary Zinge, at the Society's headquarters in Undercity.

faq.q: What will Apothecary Zinge do with them?
aliases: what does zinge do with the hearts
faq.answer: Apothecary Zinge dissects and tests the samples. The Royal Apothecary Society catalogs and weaponizes new toxins to develop plagues and concoctions for Queen Sylvanas.
The wolves came from Silverpine Forest, where dark magic, decay, and strange corruption afflict the wilds and alter the local fauna.

angles.text: As an Undead, you depend on the Royal Apothecary Society's pursuit of lethal reagents to defend the Forsaken against living and undead enemies alike.
